description: This Python source file provides utility functions for image preprocessing and decoding ImageNet model predictions. It includes functions to preprocess image tensors (including color channel reversal and mean pixel subtraction) and to decode prediction outputs into human-readable class labels with associated scores, utilizing a global class index mapping.

methods.name: preprocess_input(x)
methods.description: Preprocesses a tensor encoding a batch of images by converting RGB to BGR and mean-centering each color channel.

methods.name: decode_predictions(preds, top=5)
methods.description: Decodes the predictions of an ImageNet model into class labels and scores, initializing class index mapping if necessary.
